items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: A fellow named June Clark, a great trumpet player. I think you might remember him as being Ray Robinson's second.

ctx.x: Right down there, so here I am, at that time I didn't -- I was there and so yes, son, what do you want. I had my little bag and it was hot and I had a big woolen suit on and the suit looked good, so -- yes, son, what do you want now.

I say, 'I want to come in.' (Unintelligible)/ Yeah, how old are you? 18, sir. Now, wait now, and then Teddy Hill saw me and he said come on in here, man and (unintelligible) June Clark said yes, and I sit down and that waiter come over wiping the table, see those waiters can wipe those tables, you know, watching you. What kind of Coca Cola you want.
